**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor defensive and energy resilience: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%). Maintain selectivity; reduce exposure to persistent weakness in XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%).

BEARISH: If technology weakness extends, monitor XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) for further deterioration.

BEARISH: If precious-metals weakness persists, monitor GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -6.40%) and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.42% | 1M: -15.45%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
Monitor VXX at 18.72, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%); HYG/LQD at 0.7419, falling (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%); and SPY/TLT at 9.3431, falling (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%). These are current readings, not technical support or resistance levels.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, showing broad strength but conflicting with rising fear and weakening risk ratios. Energy and defensive ETFs are showing relative strength, while style leadership remains mixed. Monitor whether credit weakness and VXX strength persist despite broad sector participation.
